specialRules.name: "If that fell Kingdom should rise again, Rivendell, Lórien, the Shire, even Gondor itself shall fall."
specialRules.text: Friendly Angmar Orc models within 3" of a friendly Spirit Hero model gain the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: Sense of Hopelessness
specialRules.text: If an enemy Hero model is slain in Combat, then for the duration of the following turn, all enemy models suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: The Shadows of Angmar
specialRules.text: Friendly Spirit models gain the Stalk Unseen special rule.

units.name: Gulavhar, The Terror of Arnor
units.keywords: SPIRIT, ANGMAR, HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Strength of Body, Strength of Will
specialRules.text: Gûlavhar's Attacks are always equal to its remaining Wounds. Additionally, for each Wound Gûlavhar has lost, worsen Gûlavhar's Courage value by 1 (this will improve again should Gûlavhar regain a lost Wound via the Immortal Hunger special rule below).

specialRules.name: Immortal Hunger
specialRules.text: Each time Gûlavhar slays a model in Combat, it regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. These Wounds are regained at the end of the Combat. Gûlavhar can only regain Wounds in this way by making Strikes, never by using a Brutal Power Attack.

units.name: The Shadow of Rhudaur
magicalPowers: Fog of Disarray - Range Self - Casting Value 3+

specialRules.name: Herald of Doom
specialRules.text: At the beginning of the game, after both sides have been deployed, choose one Hero model in your opponent's Army. Whilst the Shadow of Rhudaur is within 6" of the chosen Hero, that Hero suffers a -1 penalty to their Fate Rolls and a -1 penalty to any Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: Powers of Angmar
specialRules.text: If the Shadow of Rhudaur rolls a natural 6 when making a Casting Roll, then the target model cannot spend Will Points to attempt to Resist the Magical Power.

specialRules.name: Scavenge
specialRules.text: Whenever Nazthák slays an enemy model in Combat (with the exception of Monster models), he may choose to scavenge a single piece of wargear carried by that model, with the exception of a Mount, another type of armour, living creatures, the One Ring, or items of wargear that are integral to the model (such as claws and teeth). This will happen before any effects that allow the slain model to pass on that piece of wargear. Add the scavenged item to Nazthák's list of wargear. Nazthák will benefit from the scavenged wargear as if he was the original model. Nazthák may choose to discard any piece of scavenged wargear at any time, though if he does so then he cannot reclaim it - it is lost.

units.name: Shade
wargear: An Amalgamation of Grasping Spectral Hands (hand weapons)

specialRules.name: Conduit of Angmar
specialRules.text: If a Ringwraith model is within 6" of a friendly Shade, they may use the Shade to determine range and Line of Sight for a Magical Power. Additionally, after making a Casting Roll within 6" of a friendly Shade, a Ringwraith can choose to deal a single Wound to the Shade to add 1 to the Casting Roll.

specialRules.name: Swirling Mists
specialRules.text: At the start of the Shoot Phase, before the Declare Heroic Actions step, a Shade may spend a Will Point to use this ability. If it does, then for the remainder of the turn, enemy models will suffer a -1 penalty To Hit when making a shooting attack that targets a friendly model within 6" of the Shade. If the enemy model making the shooting attack is also within 12" of the Shade, they will suffer a -2 penalty To Hit instead.

specialRules.name: Ghostly Resolve
specialRules.text: Friendly Angmar Orc models within 12" of one or more models with this special rule gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: Packlord
specialRules.text: Friendly models may not benefit from the Heroic Actions or Stand Fast of this model unless they have the Warg keyword.

units.name: Angmar Orc Shaman
magicalPowers: Instill Fear - Range Self - Casting Value 3+

specialRules.name: A Fell Light is in Them
specialRules.text: At the end of this model's Move, it can choose a single enemy model within 12" and Line of Sight. The chosen model must take an Intelligence Test. If the test is failed, you may Move the chosen model up to its Move Value directly towards this model, even if it has already Moved that turn. The chosen model will stop Moving if it would enter the Control Zone of an enemy model (with the exception of this model), if it comes into contact with an Obstacle, another model, or piece of impassable terrain, or if the model reaches the edge of a cliff or other such edge that would cause it to take falling damage. This Move cannot be used to Move a model out of Combat, make a model dismount, drop an item or Lie Down. However, if this Move would allow the chosen model to Charge this model, then this model may make them Charge.

specialRules.name: Feral Charge
specialRules.text: When a Werewolf Charges an enemy Infantry model, they gain the Knock to the Ground bonus as if they were Cavalry. This bonus is lost if they are subsequently charged by an enemy Cavalry model.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Shadows of Angmar army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text for Angmar units from the Arnor & Angmar faction page; the Spectre stat block is from the Mordor faction page (Spectres are a generic Spirit unit not repeated on the Angmar page).
